title: 1/2 Price Pirelli Tyres @ mycar Tyre & Auto
body:
Deal: 1/2 Price Pirelli Tyres @ mycar Tyre & Auto

[Fuzor] Aren't top tier brands all supposed to be pretty much the same? And seems really weird for a car's factory tyres to have these problems as the manufacturer is supposed to have tested these specific tyres just for the car
[Tleyx] No the major brands can be different but to say all pirellis are bad because the one on the Mustang was is stupid
[MrZ] Where did I say that ALL Pirellis are bad? I just said I wouldn't buy them again based on my experience with them.
[teatea] @MrZ: You didn't list a particular model. So you pretty much said they were all bad.
[MrZ] @teatea: Nice try. I said the Pirellis that came with my car were terrible. It's not my problem if you don't know what model tyres they are (they were P Zero, by the way, easy to find on Google). Why would you assume that I was talking about all Pirellis?
[2027] @MrZ:
I wouldn't even pay 1/2 price for Pirellis.
The P Zero, or all Pirellis?
[GregRust] @MrZ: You generalised with 2 fairly broad statements. You left out the details about which Pirelli tyres your car came with, and then again when you said your Michelin tyres were better. It was implied by both of your statements that all Pirelli tyres are bad and that all Michelin tyres are better than all Pirelli tyres.
If you want to avoid confusion then you needed to provide a lot more detail - the blame lies squarely with you for poor sentence structure.
[MrZ] @GregRust: The only thing I did "wrong" in my original comment was leave out the name of the tyres. That doesn't change the meaning at all of what I wrote/said. Any normal person would be able to figure out I was talking about the specific tyres that came with my car, and not all Pirellis in general. That said, I still wouldn't buy ANY Pirelli tyre, even at 1/2 price, based on my bad experience with them… why risk it? That's not the same as me saying all Pirellis are rubbish.
[commandershephard] @MrZ: Dunno why you’re getting downvoted.
I have had bad experiences with p zero.
I prefer Michelin and on the basis of my p zero experience I am unlikely to try Pirelli again
[woodencupboard] So on a performance car 20,000km worn out tyres are bad and new tyres are good? Thanks mate!
[aedomsan] 20k kms on tyres on something bought to thrash around, and they’re surprised it’s no longer good, lmao
[MrZ] I don't "thrash it around" - I drive it normally. And it was actually less than 20k, though I can't remember the exact figure.
[Dollar General] If they are low profile than that’s about what’s expected
[Jackson] Don't get the powergy tyres, get the standard eco tyres. Otherwise they will wear out in 20k km, they are softer compound and alsoni heard tread depth when new isn't as good.
Having said that the ecos are probably not going to be to your liking if you find the powergy slippery. Personally I find them fine but I neither drive a mustang nor am I a hoon
[Harsh Deep] who doesn't response at all even after many messages.
[arcticmonkey] I hate the pump and dumps aka advertise and don't bother responding.
[J0hn] Pirelli are grippy but doesn't last long
[boozed] That's usually how it works…
You also have to be sure you're comparing equivalent products.
[apm2011] My Pirelli All-Terrain tyres still look new after 50k.
[Fuzor] For the size that fits mine, the low end Bridgestones at Costco costs about $200 more than the Pirelli's
[Sam816] Pirellis are good to lateral grip especially on high speed hence wear down fast. Hankook are better for EVs. Michelin and continentals for ice cars.
[rodgyramjet] @George Washington: thought they shot ppl in the streets of trumpville
[Brick50] P Zero PZ4 are currently showing as $659 in my size
https://www.mycar.com.au/tyres/pirelli/p-zero-pz4/255-45R19/…
I paid $274 each + $30 fitting each at AC Tyres. So even at half price they are still more expensive, can't comment on aus stock vs grey import tyres though but everyone seems happy with Tempe Tyres in Sydney. AC Tyres basically dropship from Tempe tyres warehouse in melb
[gamer9119] Will there be issues with car insurance claims if using grey import tyres if getting into an accident? Thanks
[bargainshooter] How would that work if not your fault? If it's your fault does it matter how you caused it?
[Aap Ke Papa] Got the Yokohama Advan Apex V601 245/45R19 from bobjane for $1000 including alignment which is a good price i think
[teereb] Yeah I think I got the same yokos same dimensions for my car last month, $975 or something. Was pretty happy (The service place said they would need another 5 hours, AND $1470 to fit new tyres; conti ecos- no thanks, i'm only here for the warranty)
[CheapCookie] Take note of the price of them now and compare during the offer.
They might jack the price up then chuck half price off on the tyres, come offer time.
[boozed] They already quote over $800 for PZ5s in a size I require, when other retailers are below $500 before discounts. This should be good…
[lawyerz] Just… Make sure you actually get the right Pirelli tyres you paid for. Dodgy Northland mycar tried to put mismatched models on my car's some years back, and when told, tried to convince me to keep it.
Please check before driving off
[Ginger1] I agree, used western suburbs store, based on my personal experience, it’s worth checking whether another retailer is willing to price-match, this mob would be my last option.
[351pwr] Good deal. Recently bought 4 x pirelli scorpian atr 265/65R17 @ $260 with wheel alignment included, couldn't wait for this deal due to a blowout.
Price for these tyres currently is $399 @ my car and 1/2 price would bring it down to $199.5 ~ $800 plus wheel alignment
[movieman] So, depending on the wheel alignment cost, may end up being quite similar…
[351pwr] yea true, say $120 for a wheel alignment with mycar and $800 for the tyres then the total would be approximately $920.
I paid $1040 through tyre power with wheel alignment included, not bad considering I needed to change the tyres urgently
[Jackson] I have been hanging out for this deal and with zero advertising so far I called them on Friday and the rep I spoke to said they hadn't had it officially confirmed yet but it's should be happening and therefore I was holding off posting
[prodnus] Does anyone know if they'll swap one of your recent tyres onto the spare and mount new onto the normal wheels?
[pwnd] Depending on where you do it, they will either do it for free, or more likely for a very small cost. $20ish
[11112007] Website will go down for sure for the fourth year running. lol.
[DingoBlue] For anyone that needs this:
performance = grip
grip = soft
soft = wear
[MS Paint] Wasn't it 50% off RRP last year and not as good as the previous 50% off usual street price?

[Matt P] Assuming Model Y or SL7, already better deals out there than these at half price.
[D6C1] I only need a spare. Is there usually a minimum number of tyres to buy?
[2027] lol a post based on “trust me bro”, from a brand new account…
[salem] Are any manufacturers still doing widish performance but still daily useful in an R15? My beloved mr2 sw20 needs some new shoes badly. Toyo t1r on there currently and they're starting to perish after so long (been off the road a while now…)
[Lets Make Sandwiches] These deals never materialise, and never any stock in the tyre you need. Have to call up also……major hassle and never get any tyres each year.
[jv] I booked online last year. No dramas… It worked fine.
[FerreroRocher] Yeah same here. No issue with online booking and getting them fitted.
[JIMB0] I just buy them from my local tyre shop who does them for 2/3 of the regular mycar price. They're so busy they don't even try to upsell unnecessary extra services. My brakes are fine and the wheel alignment was check just a few years ago.
[Spend2save] I needed a new tyre this week, once quoted I said I was aware of Black Friday 50% off Pirelli coming, since I had bought previously. Asked to honour and booked in for yesterday. So can confirm 50% off is happening again, already scored the deal! Paid $224.50 for 1x SCORPION VERDE ALL SEASON XL (LR) 105V
[ccrap] Ooh that was clever. Might try that at my local. I usually get them from this deal each time so they have me on the file
